provenance.raw_source_directory: raw native imagegen sources retained in reproducibility package
provenance.source_alpha: Every final source alpha equals corresponding immutable native source alpha byte-for-byte; native geometry and texture coordinates unchanged. RGB intentionally graded before registration.

walk.anatomical_measurement: Approved walking anatomical ruler: skull crown to sole about491px; same shared ruler for six alternating phases, not each silhouette bounding box.
walk.action_semantics: Rightward heel-toe walk, wide/narrow/pass alternating legs.

low_sweep.anatomical_measurement: Approved original low-sweep ruler: ready crown/neck/pelvis/knee/ankle chain equivalent510px. Shared across crouches so the low pose is not inflated.
low_sweep.action_semantics: Low grounded needle sweep toward screen right.

victory.anatomical_measurement: Victory standing anatomy measured skull crown near30, neck near110, pelvis245, knee370, soles510; shared505px standing-equivalent ruler.
victory.action_semantics: Relaxed turn, ponytail sweep, hand on hip, confident greeting.

run.anatomical_measurement: Run upper-row first half: skull/neck about85px, torso145px, unfolded thigh/shin/shoe305px =535px. Opposite-pair source has900px ruler, opposite pass source750px, measured by the same anatomical landmark ratios; no silhouette-height normalization.
run.action_semantics: Rightward run, alternating planted and airborne phases.

idle.anatomical_measurement: Standing frame 1 anatomical crown (not ponytail) through neck and pelvis; continue down the less-foreshortened bent supporting leg through knee, ankle and plantar sole. Other frames are visually same-scale.
idle.action_semantics: Six distinct breathing/ready poses, feet planted.

jump.anatomical_measurement: Use extended takeoff frame 2 as principal ruler and cross-check the pelvis-to-knee-to-ankle chain in crouch/apex frames after unfolding. Raised arms and lifted feet do not enter ruler.
jump.action_semantics: Squat, takeoff, rising, apex, descent, landing.

hurt.anatomical_measurement: Crown-to-neck plus the unbent torso/spine from flinch frame 1 and guarded frame 2; unfolded thigh/shin/sole, cross-checked against recovery frame 6. Do not shrink the hunched frames to their shorter screen-height.
hurt.action_semantics: Impact flinch, abdominal bend, pain, partial recovery.

down.anatomical_measurement: Frame 1 uses upright head/neck, neck/pelvis and longer extended leg. Later frames follow rotated neck-to-pelvis and unfold the longer visible leg; count ankle-to-plantar-sole thickness rather than the forward toe projection. Frame 6 about 65 + 150 + 235 = 450px.
down.action_semantics: Fall from standing; final two poses horizontal prone, final eyes closed.

recovering.anatomical_measurement: Frame 1 MUST reuse actual down6 crop and its 450px ruler/root. Elbow/palm/kneel/crouch frames use crown-neck, rotated torso and unfolded visible thigh/shin chain. Standing frame 6 is about 85 + 180 + 285 = 550px, distinctly larger than the early prone poses.
recovering.action_semantics: Start prone, elbow/seat, palm/knee, crouch, finish ready.

launched.anatomical_measurement: On native 1774×887 source, measure crown-to-neck along tilted head, torso to pelvis and one unfolded thigh/knee/shin/ankle/sole chain; airborne translation, hair, open arms and extended toes are excluded.
launched.action_semantics: Backward airborne knockback, rotate horizontal, brace to land.

stunned.anatomical_measurement: Use frame 1 neck/pelvis and the less-foreshortened supporting leg, cross-check frame 6 upright torso. For forehead-clutch frames unfold knees/torso; do not count high ponytail or hand on crown as body height.
stunned.action_semantics: Dizzy stagger and forehead clutch, feet on ground.

light1.anatomical_measurement: Crown excludes high ponytail. Follow neck to covered pelvis, then screen-left rear thigh and shin to ankle and sole. Unfolded chain is about 385px; corrected source has genuinely smaller anatomy than all other combat sheets.
light1.action_semantics: Chest-height right-hand needle throw; projectiles are separate.

light2.anatomical_measurement: Use crown, collar/neck and pelvis under skirt, then long visible rear-leg thigh/shin with sandal sole. Raw visual chain approximately 510px; cross-check frame 6 near 500px. Adopt 500px rounded standing equivalent.

light3.anatomical_measurement: Standing support-leg chain in knee-raised frame 2 is approximately 461px before small depth/occlusion allowance, giving ~470px. Frames 1 and 6 require unfolding their wide stance and measure nearer 495–505px. Arms, kick toe extent and ponytail are excluded.
light3.action_semantics: Turning roundhouse kick: pivot, knee raise, high kick, follow-through, plant.

air_light.anatomical_measurement: Frame 3 extended screen-right leg provides the least-occluded ruler: crown/neck/pelvis and unfolded thigh-shin-foot is ~514px, with modest depth allowance about 520–525px. For tucked frames 1–2, use full femur/shin lengths cross-checked against frames 3–5 rather than apparent tucked height.

rising.anatomical_measurement: Rising frame 3 crown-to-neck, neck-to-pelvis and visible bent leg chain is ~477px; the upright support leg of frame 4 gives a lower ~450px check. Adopt ~465px. Raised fist, ponytail and jump displacement are excluded.
rising.action_semantics: Low coil into a rising needle throw/uppercut.

dash_strike.anatomical_measurement: Extreme frame 4 follows skull/neck, inclined torso and extended rear thigh/shin to sandal. Raw polyline ~546px; hip/foot-axis allowance gives ~535px. Frames1,2,6 cross-check near490–505px, so 500px is a sensible sheet baseline.

throw.anatomical_measurement: Hip-turn frame3 yields ~501px from crown/neck/pelvis through front thigh, shin and sole. Forward-folded frame4 is measured by torso-plus-leg chains rather than its crouched silhouette height.
throw.action_semantics: Reach/grab imaginary opponent, hip turn, shoulder throw, recovery.

heavy1.anatomical_measurement: Shared 510px standing-equivalent ruler: inspected skull-to-neck about75px, neck-to-pelvis150px, unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain285px, keeping the six wide-stance phases at one body scale.
heavy1.action_semantics: Normal longbow shot: left grip, right-hand draw to cheek, release, recover.

heavy2.anatomical_measurement: Shared 500px standing-equivalent ruler: inspected skull-to-neck75px, torso140px, unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain285px; low coil is not scaled by its short silhouette.
heavy2.action_semantics: Forceful longbow volley, rising into a wide full-draw stance.

charged_upper.anatomical_measurement: Shared 500px standing-equivalent ruler: inspected skull-to-neck80px, torso135px, unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain285px across raised-arm poses.
charged_upper.action_semantics: High-angle archery shot toward screen right.

charged_slam.anatomical_measurement: Shared 520px standing-equivalent ruler: inspected skull-to-neck80px, torso150px, unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain290px; deep lunges retain the same scale.
charged_slam.action_semantics: Forward ice-wave/arrow shot, downward follow-through; effects separate.

air_heavy.anatomical_measurement: Shared 510px standing-equivalent ruler: inspected skull-to-neck80px, torso135px, unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain295px, using bent limb segment anatomy instead of airborne bounds.
air_heavy.action_semantics: Airborne archery shot aimed right/down, then landing preparation.

dash_heavy.anatomical_measurement: Shared 525px standing-equivalent ruler: inspected skull-to-neck85px, torso140px, unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain300px across lunge and recovery.
dash_heavy.action_semantics: Two-handed horizontal longbow bash, NOT an archery draw.

guard.anatomical_measurement: Shared 500px standing-equivalent ruler: inspected skull-to-neck80px, torso140px, unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain280px. Defensive recoil uses this same ruler.
guard.action_semantics: Two-handed diagonal longbow guard and impact recoil.

special.anatomical_measurement: Shared 510px standing-equivalent ruler: inspected skull-to-neck80px, torso145px, unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain285px, shared across three draws/releases.
special.action_semantics: Powerful repeated archery draws/releases, no baked effects.
